description: Find sections of the North Carolina Constitution by words in the heading or text, e.g. "eminent domain", "jury trial", "right to bear arms", "equal protection". Returns matching article and section numbers with headings and a short excerpt; call nc_constitution with the article and section for the verbatim text. Optionally restrict to one article. Keyless, live.

article.description: Optional: only search this article (1-14 or Roman numeral).

name: nc_constitution_search
title: Nc Constitution Search
